argv:
echo "==WHICH=="; command -v crontab; echo "==CUR=="; crontab -l 2>&1 | head -20; echo "==COUNT=="; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | wc -l
CUR="$(crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true)"
echo "$CUR" | grep -q 'ontrack-voice-link/worker.py' || CUR="$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$CUR" '* * * * * /bin/python3 /home/appontrack/ontrack-voice-link/worker.py >/dev/null 2>&1 # ontrack-voice-link')"
echo "$CUR" | grep -q 'run-queue.sh' || CUR="$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$CUR" '* * * * * /bin/bash /home/appontrack/bin/run-queue.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 # ontrack-saas-build')"
printf '%s\n' "$CUR" | crontab - 2>&1
echo "==AFTER=="; crontab -l 2>&1 | head -20
echo "==STATUS=="; cat "$HOME/logs/bootstrap-laravel.status" 2>/dev/null || echo NO_STATUS
echo "==LOGT=="; tail -12 "$HOME/logs/bootstrap-laravel.log" 2>/dev/null || echo NO_LOG
echo "==SAAS=="; ls -a /home/appontrack/public_html/saas 2>/dev/null | head -18
echo "==ARTISAN=="; if [ -f /home/appontrack/public_html/saas/artisan ]; then /opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php /home/appontrack/public_html/saas/artisan --version 2>&1 | head -2; else echo NO_ARTISAN; fi
echo "=DONE="
